# PhotoSwipe compatibility renderer

Version: 4.1.3. License: MIT; see PHOTOSWIPE-LICENSE.
Source: https://registry.npmjs.org/photoswipe/-/photoswipe-4.1.3.tgz

Pinned upstream distribution for captured WooCommerce PhotoSwipe 4 markup. The builder includes core, default UI and its local-data adapter only on declared gallery pages; it does not execute captured source scripts. Source CSS supplies the appearance. Newer PhotoSwipe markup is not automatically supported.

Unmodified upstream assets:

- scripts/vendor-photoswipe.js SHA-256: 78fc260a16dbbd76ec3b4da56ccdc7a076d21d31c501e0a17a4175c4a25d95ea
- scripts/vendor-photoswipe-ui.js SHA-256: 50a9333a7ff0d660714662cb1ab49ec81e1ed716eba78c729600166f7338da95

Keep the copyright headers and license when updating. Recheck source/export controls, captions, fullscreen, keyboard, focus, CSP and reduced motion against installed fixtures after changing the renderer.
